learning_outcomes.text: Give knowledge and skills about who does what and with whom in the organisation for achieving its strategic aims.

syllabus_topics: Gist and application of the scientific course Staff Management
Development of the organization of human resources
Management of the quality of work of human resources
Management of remuneration, health-keeping and safety at work
Management of human relationships; team work

assessment_methods.method: individual presentations and/or course assignment (continuous assessment)
written and oral exam (two questions and a test)

assessment_rules: Assessment is continuous and uses a score system. Students can voluntarily take part in three written tests, which are also assessed by using a score system. Receiving a total score of over 50% from the maximum, students are exempt from the exam and can receive a mark corresponding to their score. The exam includes two questions and a test. The semester is verified if classes are attended regularly.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
